changeSet.author: shurapilipuk@gmail.com
changeSet.comment: Test data for hotels from hotel schema
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.hotels (name, rating, address_id, created_at) SELECT CONCAT('Hotel', gs) AS name, CASE WHEN random() < 0.5 THEN 5 ELSE 4 END AS rating, gs AS address_id, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS gs;

changeSet.author: shurapilipuk@gmail.com
changeSet.comment: Test data for tmp_hotel_room_counts from hotel schema
changeSet.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_hotel_room_counts AS SELECT id AS hotel_id, FLOOR(random() * 19 + 10)::int AS room_count FROM hotel.hotels;
